Draw precisely this friendly large-headed beige freckled alien with blue eyes, olive sleeveless utility vest, beige undershirt, brown cargo trousers and substantial dark lace-up boots. Preserve the reference's oversized head-to-body proportions and realistic detailed 3D rendered material finish in ALL eight frames. True SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT for every pose. Fixed orthographic camera, no rotation toward viewer. EXACTLY EIGHT full-body frames in 4 columns and 2 rows, row-major timeline, no additional sprites. Canvas 2048x1024; each equal cell512x512. Frame8 recover upright exactly same stance and size as frame1. Physical joint articulation and coherent vertical trajectory; no horizontal translation.
